passage.label: An-Nisa — Disbelievers driven into Fire, skins replaced to taste punishment; believers admitted to Gardens with rivers, purified spouses, deep shade; Allah commands rendering trusts to rightful owners and judging between people with justice; excellent instruction; Allah Hearing Seeing; obey Allah, Messenger, and those in authority; refer disputes to Allah and Messenger if believing in Allah and Last Day; those claiming faith yet seeking judgment from taghut though commanded to reject it; shaytan wishes to mislead far; hypocrites turn away when called to revelation and Messenger; disaster strikes because of what hands put forward then come swearing intended goodwill; Allah knows hearts so turn away admonish speak penetrating word; no messenger sent except to be obeyed by Allah's leave; if came seeking forgiveness and Messenger sought forgiveness would find Allah Accepting Merciful; by your Lord they do not believe until making you judge in disputes finding no discomfort and submitting fully

arabicExcerpts.text: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا سَوۡفَ نُصۡلِيهِمۡ نَارٗا كُلَّمَا نَضِجَتۡ جُلُودُهُم بَدَّلۡنَٰهُمۡ جُلُودًا غَيۡرَهَا لِيَذُوقُواْ ٱلۡعَذَابَۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَزِيزًا حَكِيمٗا

وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَٰتِ سَنُدۡخِلُهُمۡ جَنَّـٰتٖ تَجۡرِي مِن تَحۡتِهَا ٱلۡأَنۡهَٰرُ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَآ أَبَدٗاۖ لَّهُمۡ فِيهَآ أَزۡوَٰجٞ مُّطَهَّرَةٞۖ وَنُدۡخِلُهُمۡ ظِلّٗا ظَلِيلًا

۞إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَأۡمُرُكُمۡ أَن تُؤَدُّواْ ٱلۡأَمَٰنَٰتِ إِلَىٰٓ أَهۡلِهَا وَإِذَا حَكَمۡتُم بَيۡنَ ٱلنَّاسِ أَن تَحۡكُمُواْ بِٱلۡعَدۡلِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ نِعِمَّا يَعِظُكُم بِهِۦٓۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ سَمِيعَۢا بَصِيرٗا

يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓاْ أَطِيعُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُواْ ٱلرَّسُولَ وَأُوْلِي ٱلۡأَمۡرِ مِنكُمۡۖ فَإِن تَنَٰزَعۡتُمۡ فِي شَيۡءٖ فَرُدُّوهُ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَٱلرَّسُولِ إِن كُنتُمۡ تُؤۡمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلۡيَوۡمِ ٱلۡأٓخِرِۚ ذَٰلِكَ خَيۡرٞ وَأَحۡسَنُ تَأۡوِيلًا

أَلَمۡ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يَزۡعُمُونَ أَنَّهُمۡ ءَامَنُواْ بِمَآ أُنزِلَ إِلَيۡكَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ مِن قَبۡلِكَ يُرِيدُونَ أَن يَتَحَاكَمُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلطَّـٰغُوتِ وَقَدۡ أُمِرُوٓاْ أَن يَكۡفُرُواْ بِهِۦۖ وَيُرِيدُ ٱلشَّيۡطَٰنُ أَن يُضِلَّهُمۡ ضَلَٰلَۢا بَعِيدٗا
وَإِذَا قِيلَ لَهُمۡ تَعَالَوۡاْ إِلَىٰ مَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ وَإِلَى ٱلرَّسُولِ رَأَيۡتَ ٱلۡمُنَٰفِقِينَ يَصُدُّونَ عَنكَ صُدُودٗا
فَكَيۡفَ إِذَآ أَصَٰبَتۡهُم مُّصِيبَةُۢ بِمَا قَدَّمَتۡ أَيۡدِيهِمۡ ثُمَّ جَآءُوكَ يَحۡلِفُونَ بِٱللَّهِ إِنۡ أَرَدۡنَآ إِلَّآ إِحۡسَٰنٗا وَتَوۡفِيقًا
أُوْلَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَعۡلَمُ ٱللَّهُ مَا فِي قُلُوبِهِمۡ فَأَعۡرِضۡ عَنۡهُمۡ وَعِظۡهُمۡ وَقُل لَّهُمۡ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ قَوۡلَۢا بَلِيغٗا

وَمَآ أَرۡسَلۡنَا مِن رَّسُولٍ إِلَّا لِيُطَاعَ بِإِذۡنِ ٱللَّهِۚ وَلَوۡ أَنَّهُمۡ إِذ ظَّلَمُوٓاْ أَنفُسَهُمۡ جَآءُوكَ فَٱسۡتَغۡفَرُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَٱسۡتَغۡفَرَ لَهُمُ ٱلرَّسُولُ لَوَجَدُواْ ٱللَّهَ تَوَّابٗا رَّحِيمٗا
فَلَا وَرَبِّكَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُونَ حَتَّىٰ يُحَكِّمُوكَ فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيۡنَهُمۡ ثُمَّ لَا يَجِدُواْ فِيٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ حَرَجٗا مِّمَّا قَضَيۡتَ وَيُسَلِّمُواْ تَسۡلِيمٗا

mainSubject.label: Eschatological contrast: disbelievers driven into Fire where skins are repeatedly replaced to perpetuate punishment; believers admitted to Gardens beneath which rivers flow eternally with purified spouses and deep shade; Allah commands rendering trusts (amanat) to rightful owners and judging between people with justice (adl); obedience hierarchy: Allah, Messenger, and those in authority (uli al-amr); dispute resolution by referral to Allah and Messenger as condition of faith in Allah and Last Day; condemnation of those claiming faith yet seeking taghut judgment despite command to reject it; shaytan's intent to mislead far; hypocrites turning away in aversion when called to revelation and Messenger; disaster striking due to own hands' deeds then coming with oaths of good intent; Allah knows what is in hearts — turn away, admonish, speak penetrating word; messengers sent solely to be obeyed by Allah's permission; intercession pathway: if wrongdoers came to Prophet seeking forgiveness and he sought forgiveness for them they would find Allah Accepting Merciful; oath by Lord: true faith requires accepting Prophet's judgment without inner resistance and submitting completely (tasleeman)

notes: Pass A Nisa passage 7/8. Central governance passage establishing trust-rendering and justice (4:58), obedience hierarchy (4:59), and dispute referral mechanism. Defines hypocrisy through behavioral markers: seeking taghut, turning away, swearing false oaths after disaster. Verse 4:64 establishes prophetic intercession pathway. Climactic oath (4:65) defines faith itself as complete acceptance of prophetic judgment without inner resistance (haraj). Tasleeman as total submission becomes defining marker of true belief.
